name: Energy Storage
description: Historical development of energy storage technologies, Energy storage options to balance renewable energy systems, Working principles of various energy storage technologies, Energy storage technologies for short-duration – Supercapacitors, flywheel and superconducting magnets; Energy Storage Technologies for medium-duration – electrochemical batteries; Energy Storage Technologies for Long-duration – chemical energy storage, pumped hydro storage, and thermal energy storage; Integration/sizing of energy storage systems and energy storage system optimization; technoeconomic, social and environmental analysis of energy storage solutions for specific applications
